clue.text: Mad Hatter retains majority as heat controller

indicators.note: to retain is to hold on to, so the scrambled word keeps another piece held inside it
a mad thing is deranged, so the word after it gets its letters thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
the majority is the greater part, most of it

explanation.surface: The Mad Hatter of Alice in Wonderland somehow ends up in charge of the heating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad Hatter' reads as Lewis Carroll's character, but 'Mad' is the signal to rearrange the second word.
explanation.definitionFit: A thermostat is the device that switches a heating system on and off to keep a set temperature.

clue.text: Subject to endless choice

indicators.note: without an end, so the final letter of the word for choice is cut off

parts.note: taken as written
your pick is your choice

explanation.surface: Something is said to be dependent on an unending series of choices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Subject to' reads as one phrase meaning dependent on, but the split comes after 'Subject'.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is the subject of a talk, essay or conversation, the matter being discussed.

clue.text: Coming out from Greece men appear in difficulties

indicators.note: people in difficulties are in a mess, so the letters before this phrase are jumbled up

parts.note: the nine letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Something emerges from Greek men who seem to be in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergence is the act of coming out into view from somewhere hidden or enclosed.

clue.text: Old-time dandy a big VIP of course

parts.note: an eighteenth-century fop who affected continental fashions was called a macaroni
a big cheese is an important person

explanation.surface: A description of an antique fashionable gentleman who is also a very important person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of course' looks like a casual aside but is the definition: a dish served as a course of a meal. The macaroni of Yankee Doodle was a dandy.
explanation.definitionFit: Macaroni cheese is a dish served as part of a meal, so it is something that comes as a course.

clue.text: His job backing horses?

parts.note: surface reading: a man whose work is betting on horses
setter's reading: a craftsman whose work goes on the backs of horses, making the seats riders sit on

explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing' suggests placing bets; the question mark signals the literal sense, things that go on a horse's back.
explanation.definitionFit: A saddler makes and sells saddles and other leather tack fitted on horses' backs.

clue.text: . Parade left here for foreign parts

parts.note: to air something is to parade or show it off
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A procession sets off from this place, bound for overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like the past tense of leave, which suits the surface, but it is the nautical side. The stray full stop is a scanning mark.
explanation.definitionFit: An airport is the place travellers depart from when flying abroad to other countries.

clue.text: Carmen would hope to avoid this second child?

definitions.text: Carmen would hope to avoid this

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second
a kid is a child

explanation.surface: Bizet's opera heroine Carmen hopes not to have another baby.
explanation.walkthrough: Carmen is not the opera heroine but 'car men', drivers, who dread losing their grip on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A skid is a sliding loss of traction that every driver hopes never to experience on the road.

clue.text: What suited Tommy a sine qua non for the motorist, might one say?

indicators.note: asks how the phrase sounds when spoken, so the answer matches its pronunciation

parts.words: a sine qua non for the motorist
parts.note: a driver cannot start without the key to the car

explanation.surface: A riddle about a soldier's clothes and an indispensable item for drivers.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy, or Tommy Atkins, is the nickname for a British private soldier. In non-rhotic British speech the colour and the motorist's essential sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: British soldiers wore uniform made of dull brownish cloth, so their suits were of that colour.

clue.text: Old French transport industry

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a public stagecoach once used in France
second meaning: hard work and steady effort

explanation.walkthrough: 'Industry' reads as manufacturing, as if this were French transport manufacturing, but it means hard-working.
explanation.definitionFit: Industry in the sense of hard work is a synonym, and a diligence was a French stagecoach.

clue.text: During which Frederic was bound to be a pirate

definitions.text: During which Frederic was bound to be a pirate

parts.words: Frederic was bound to be a pirate
parts.note: surface reading: Frederic was certain to end up a pirate
setter's reading: the period of training for which Frederic, hero of The Pirates of Penzance, was formally indentured to the pirates

explanation.walkthrough: In Gilbert and Sullivan's The Pirates of Penzance, Frederic's nurse mishears 'pilot' and indentures him to a pirate; 'bound' means legally contracted, not destined.
explanation.definitionFit: An apprenticeship is a fixed term in which a young person is bound by contract to learn a trade from a master.

clue.text: Bridge support last month suffering set-back, being holed

parts.note: a pier is a pillar supporting a bridge span

indicators.note: a set-back sends something backwards, so the word for the month is written in reverse

parts.note: December is the year's last month, abbreviated

explanation.surface: A bridge's support, damaged by last month's setback, is now full of holes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pierced has had a hole punched through it, so it has been holed.

clue.text: Artist guide for Tobias

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Italian Renaissance painter
second meaning: the archangel who travelled with young Tobias in the Book of Tobit

explanation.walkthrough: In the apocryphal Book of Tobit, the archangel accompanies Tobias on his journey in disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the High Renaissance painter of Urbino and the biblical archangel share this one name.

clue.text: Company in which soldier returned to a stream for a little smoke

indicators.note: the company word holds the following pieces inside it

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the soldier's letters run backwards

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
taken as written
a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: A firm where a returning soldier goes to a stream to have a quiet smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigarillo is a small thin cigar, so smoking one makes a little smoke.

clue.text: Regretting downfall before midnight

indicators.note: one piece comes ahead of the other in the answer

parts.note: a downfall is a person's ruin
read as mid-night: the letter in the middle of night

explanation.surface: Someone is sorry about a fall from grace just before the clock strikes twelve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Midnight' looks like a time, but it is read as mid-night, the middle letter of night.
explanation.definitionFit: To rue is to regret something deeply, so ruing means regretting it.

clue.text: Clergyman is round we hear

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a member of a cathedral chapter
second meaning: a piece of music in which voices enter one after another singing the same tune, something we hear

explanation.walkthrough: 'We hear' seems to signal a sound-alike for cannon, but it simply notes that the round is music to be listened to.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a cathedral clergyman, and also a musical piece in which one melody is imitated by successive voices.

clue.text: Message sent out of Brazilian port on top of this 26

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece sitting on another means it comes first
the message word goes round the outside of the port word

parts.note: a cable is a telegram message
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter in a down entry

parts.note: the opening letter of this

explanation.surface: A telegram is dispatched from Rio, on top of one of these vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabriolet is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage, and later a convertible car, so it is a vehicle.

clue.text: Enter into new sort of holding

indicators.note: a new sort of something is a fresh arrangement, so the preceding letters get reordered

parts.note: all nine letters rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to go into a novel kind of holding, like a smallholding or an investment.
explanation.definitionFit: Retention is the act of keeping or holding something rather than letting it go.

clue.text: It turns up in Iceland anyhow, just the same

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading from bottom to top, so the word runs backwards
the reversed word sits inside the other piece
anyhow means in a careless, haphazard way, so the country's letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something keeps turning up in Iceland in exactly the same way.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that are identical are exactly alike in every respect, just the same.

clue.text: Cheap seating for baseball fans or textile workers

definitions.meaning: first meaning: uncovered tiered benches at an American ballpark
second meaning: people who whiten cloth

explanation.definitionFit: American open-air stands are named for being sun-bleached, and workers who whiten fabric carry the same name.

clue.text: Intensify with mixture of henna and candle-ends

indicators.note: a mixture blends things together, so the letters that follow are stirred into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the ends of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of candle

explanation.surface: A recipe for a hair dye blended with the stubs of candles to make the colour stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to heighten or improve its quality, which is to intensify it.

clue.text: Urn used about five — Pacific Islands? Right

indicators.note: about means around, so the islands' name wraps round the number

parts.note: Samoa is a group of islands in the South Pacific
V is the Roman numeral for five
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: An urn has been used five times, and someone wonders if it came from the South Seas.
explanation.definitionFit: A samovar is a Russian metal urn used for heating water to make tea.

clue.text: She shows by anger one loses love

indicators.note: by means next to, so the pieces stand side by side

parts.note: ire is anger

indicators.note: to lose something is to be left without it, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A woman displays her temper, and someone loses a lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' stands for any woman's name; love as O comes from the tennis score.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is a woman's given name, so a she is a fair example for it.

clue.text: Topping one-way ticket to a warm spot

indicators.note: topping something cuts off its top, so the first letter goes

parts.note: in Britain a one-way ticket is called a single

explanation.surface: Someone buys a one-way ticket to somewhere sunny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topping' looks like an adjective meaning excellent, but it means removing the head letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a fireside or hearth, the warm spot by an open fire, as in inglenook.

clue.text: Saving one? Darling!

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a saving one, the redeeming quality in the phrase saving ...
second meaning: the first name of the lighthouse keeper's daughter famed for an 1838 sea rescue

explanation.walkthrough: 'Darling' looks like a term of endearment, but it is the surname of Grace Darling, a Victorian heroine who rowed out to rescue shipwreck survivors.
explanation.definitionFit: A saving grace redeems an otherwise poor thing, and Grace was the first name of the famous Darling.

clue.text: Hit the wrong nail (not on the head) causing extreme deformity
Levels one against one

definitions.meaning: first meaning: makes flat or equal
second meaning: betting odds of one to one

explanation.walkthrough: 'One against one' sounds like a duel but is a bookmaker's price.
explanation.definitionFit: To even things is to level them, and betting odds of one to one are called by this name.

clue.text: This officer a man of affairs?

definitions.text: This officer a man of affairs?

parts.note: surface reading: a businessman, or else a womaniser
setter's reading: the kind of officer who handles communication between units, a word that also means a love affair

explanation.walkthrough: A liaison officer coordinates between groups, and the same word means an illicit love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both coordination between parties and a secret romantic relationship.

clue.text: Conveyance for high explosive Clive organized

indicators.note: organized means arranged into order, so the letters are set out afresh

parts.note: HE is the abbreviation for high explosive
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man called Clive arranges transport for some explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle is any means of conveying people or goods, such as a car or cart.

clue.text: What we are descended from, regardless of Darwin?

definitions.text: What we are descended from, regardless of Darwin?

parts.note: surface reading: our ancestors, apes according to Darwin
setter's reading: whatever evolution says, our ancestry is drawn up as a family chart, and apes once climbed down from one too

explanation.walkthrough: A family genealogy is drawn as a branching diagram, and in Darwin's story our ape ancestors came down from the branches either way.
explanation.definitionFit: A family tree charts a person's ancestry, and primates descended from the forest canopy.

clue.text: The tube of French polish is not quite finished — capital!

indicators.note: something not quite finished lacks its end, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: the Paris underground railway is called the Métro
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tube of French polish for furniture is almost used up, which is great news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French polish' reads as one phrase, a wood finish, but 'of French' goes with the tube; the tube is the London Underground.
explanation.definitionFit: A metropolis is a country's chief city, so it can stand for a capital.
